text.tspan: Product concept preview · Demo only · No real payments

tspan.tspan: EyeBooked brings everyday eye health,
local care and eyewear discovery into one phone-first experience.
→ Find services and book appointments
→ Explore AI-assisted frame inspiration and eye-strain tips
→ Shop ready-made frames or explore custom design
→ Return through rewards and practical eye-health tools
→ English, French and Arabic with RTL support; prices in MAD
A simple sign-in followed by a dashboard for appointments,
discovery and useful eye-care actions.
Browse ready-made eyewear or explore custom frame design,
including progressive lens options.
A guided cart experience for eyewear orders, with order status stages
envisioned from preparation through delivery.
Search by proximity and city, then review sample profiles
and ratings. The product concept targets a catalog of 30+
ophthalmologists across major Moroccan cities;
A loyalty layer and practical eye-health tools
help make routine care easier to revisit.
Designed for a phone-sized experience,
with English, French and Arabic support, including right-to-left layout.
Examples are Morocco-focused and shown in MAD.
Visite the live Demo (No real payments)
The current build is a front-end prototype.
Authentication, booking, AI recommendations, checkout,
rewards, and live order tracking require production services
and integrations before launch.
Sign in with Email or phone.
Password Management.
Free trial for 7 days.
AI Face Scan and Quick Services.
Current screen profiles are sample data.
Casablanca and Rabat examples.
Sort by nearest.
